note: MS-RX-CAT-001 holds classes and generic names only. Every dose stays 'to-verify' until verified from a primary source with a verbatim quote and CSO-signed. This list adds names; it adds no dose.
incomplete: These entries name the drug and its class and nothing more. The live entry shape (routes, renal flag, high-alert flag, chart rule, dose skeleton) was not visible. Phase 0 completes each one, and until it does: the kidney check does not run for the new medicines, insulin aspart is not marked high-alert, and glimepiride does not open the glucose chart. The chart rule moves from 'oral_glucose_lowering' to the sulfonylurea class, and the old class is retired explicitly, not left dangling (review G24).

classes.label: Sulfonylurea
classes.why: Hypoglycaemia checks, the rifampicin interaction and the age-60 flag are class-specific.

classes.label: SGLT2 inhibitor
classes.why: On the WHO Model List since 2021; dapagliflozin added to EMHSLU 2023.

classes.label: DPP-4 inhibitor
classes.why: WHO 2018 alternative where insulin is unsuitable.

classes.label: GLP-1 receptor agonist
classes.why: WHO Model List 2025 (semaglutide) for type 2 diabetes with cardiovascular or kidney disease and BMI 30 or more.

classes.label: Thiazolidinedione
classes.why: WHO 2018 alternative; the heart-failure flag needs the class.

drugs.flag: Keep the entry (patients still take it) and set onEmhsluDraft false. See D-DM-22.

drugs.why: A history quick pick with no formulary entry (briefing 7.3).

diagnosisLinks.note: No antiplatelet link: it is for secondary prevention only and would show on every type 2 card (review G25).
Classes named by ADA. Held: the classes may not exist in the formulary and this pack adds no drugs to them. No opioid link.

prescribingChecks.when: metformin and latest eGFR below REF-DM-RX-METFORMIN-STOP-EGFR
prescribingChecks.note: The kidney check today reads only the latest creatinine and has no eGFR threshold. This check runs when a prescription is written; the catalog's red therapy flag metformin_egfr_below_30 covers the person already taking it.

prescribingChecks.when: new metformin prescription and latest eGFR below REF-DM-RX-METFORMIN-NOSTART-EGFR
metformin and no eGFR in the last 12 months, at a site that has lab.creatinine
prescribingChecks.note: Where the site has no creatinine the check would fire for ever: there it is shown once as 'kidney function not known; refer for creatinine'.

prescribingChecks.when: glibenclamide and age at or above REF-DM-RX-GLIB-AGE
ACE inhibitor or ARB and a current pregnancy fact
statin and a current pregnancy fact
prescribingChecks.note: ADA: stopped in most circumstances, not an absolute contraindication.

prescribingChecks.when: a sulfonylurea, SGLT2 inhibitor, GLP-1 receptor agonist, DPP-4 inhibitor or pioglitazone and a current pregnancy fact
ACE inhibitor and ARB both active
new or increased ACE inhibitor or ARB: propose creatinine and potassium in 2 to 4 weeks
new SGLT2 inhibitor and eGFR below REF-DM-RX-SGLT2-EGFR
pioglitazone and heart failure on the problem list
insulin prescribed and no glucagon or hypoglycaemia plan recorded

chartRules.when: SGLT2 inhibitor active and the patient is admitted
chartRules.opens: glucose chart with a ketone row

chartRules.when: systemic steroid prescribed to an inpatient
chartRules.opens: glucose chart, readings after lunch or before the evening meal
